## Environment (27)

| variable | default | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `HOOKJUDGE_DB` | `hookjudge.db` | The ledger — every verdict, its cost, and what it was reused for |
| `HOOKJUDGE_INGEST_SECRET` | *(empty)* | Inbound: the pipe signs its deliveries |
| `HOOKJUDGE_RULING_SECRET` | *(empty)* | /rulings/ai only |
| `HOOKJUDGE_READ_TOKEN` | *(empty)* | Guards the reads |
| `HOOKJUDGE_MAX_BODY_BYTES` | `256 * 1024` | Inbound body cap |
| `HOOKJUDGE_RETURN_URL` | *(empty)* | Outbound: where the judgement goes back to |
| `HOOKJUDGE_RETURN_SECRET` | *(empty)* | Outbound HMAC secret; signs the judgement on its way back |
| `HOOKJUDGE_RETURN_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | `6` | Attempts on the return leg before the row is dead-lettered |
| `HOOKJUDGE_WORKER_INTERVAL` | `1.0` | Return-leg tick, in seconds |
| `HOOKJUDGE_ALARM_URL` | *(empty)* | Direct self-alarm for returns that go DEAD: the pipe is the broken link at that moment, so this posts straight to a bot/collector URL |
| `HOOKJUDGE_ALARM_MIN_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | `600` | Floor between two alarm sends, so a storm cannot page repeatedly |
| `HOOKJUDGE_REUSE_WINDOW_SECONDS` | `3600` | Reuse window: how long one identity's verdict answers for restatements |
| `HOOKJUDGE_RULE_REUSE_WINDOW_SECONDS` | `0` | Widen reuse from one identity to a whole alert rule |
| `HOOKJUDGE_RETENTION_DAYS` | `30` | How long judged rows are kept; 0 disables purging entirely |
| `HOOKJUDGE_AI_BASE_URL` | *(empty)* | OpenAI-compatible base |
| `HOOKJUDGE_AI_API_KEY` | *(empty)* | Credential for the base above |
| `HOOKJUDGE_AI_MODEL` | `gpt-4o-mini` | Model name sent to that base |
| `HOOKJUDGE_AI_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `60.0` | How long one judgement may take before it falls back to the rules |
| `HOOKJUDGE_AI_BODY_LIMIT` | `4000` | Characters of the alert body sent to the model |
| `HOOKJUDGE_AI_TITLE_LIMIT` | `300` | The rest of the untrusted span in the prompt |
| `HOOKJUDGE_AI_FIELDS_LIMIT` | `2000` | How many payload fields are offered to the model |
| `HOOKJUDGE_AI_PRICE_IN_PER_1K` | `0.0` | Input price per 1k tokens, so the ledger can cost a verdict |
| `HOOKJUDGE_AI_PRICE_OUT_PER_1K` | `0.0` | Output price per 1k tokens, the other half of that sum |
| `HOOKJUDGE_AI_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT` | `auto` | schema \| tools \| object to pin one, anything else (default "auto") to negotiate downwards from the strongest the provider will accept |
| `HOOKJUDGE_BURST_WINDOW_SECONDS` | `600` | A burst is different rules from one origin inside one window |
| `HOOKJUDGE_HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | Where to listen |
| `HOOKJUDGE_PORT` | `8200` | Port the service listens on |

| method | path | what it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/` | — |
| GET | `/disagreements` | The review queue: rows where the platform and the judge disagreed |
